stage_notes.Planning: Unit objectives and significant risks inform scope and the audit program.
stage_notes.Opening Meeting: Timing and resource requirements are agreed with the unit.
stage_notes.Review & Testing: Evidence can include interviews, observation, control work and document review; observations are shared as identified.
stage_notes.Closing Meeting: Department representatives and other stakeholders finalize the executive summary and management advisory reports.
stage_notes.Reporting: Final audit report and any necessary management advisory memos are distributed.
stage_notes.Follow-Up: Audit Services verifies corrective action implementation and issues a follow-up memo.

business_process.status_model_note: These are the site's published process stages, not a native software status enumeration or a mandatory linear state machine.

implementation_notes: Represent issue date, source policy, calculated reference date and any expressly supplied action-plan date separately.
Do not replace calendar-month calculations with 180/365-day constants.

Preserve unit-reported implementation and Audit Services verification as distinct evidence. The source does not supply a native status code list.
Produce an internal follow-up queue and reviewable export; do not send actual contacts or represent an adopted University policy.

full_workflow_outline: Import the original source files and attachments while preserving record IDs, exact bytes, labels, nulls and source relationships.
Review explicit mappings for engagements, areas, activities, observations, action plans, evidence and audiences; expose missing identities and broken relationships.
Resolve source conflicts through retained corrections and decisions without replacing original artifacts.

Produce the selected target's documented native format and compare its returned export to the reviewed source selection. An arbitrary CSV is not labeled vendor-native.
Operate action follow-up with separate reference dates, supplied overrides, implementation assertions and auditor verification.
Build a complete private receiving package, reopen it independently, and retain source/output reconciliation and original review history.
Back up and restore the original working state, attachment custody, mappings, decisions and outstanding actions, preserving all IDs and access classifications.
